environment.description: Deployed on EKS 1.28 with Bottlerocket AMI nodes. Pod security context specifies allowPrivilegeEscalation: false. The container runtime (containerd 1.7.x with default seccomp) applies a restricted profile. Node-level kubelet configuration sets --protect-kernel-defaults=true. The pod spec includes securityContext.capabilities.drop containing NET_RAW and SYS_ADMIN. Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'restrict-capabilities' in audit+enforce mode validates that no pod in the namespace can add back dropped capabilities. The OPA Gatekeeper constraint K8sPSPCapabilities is also active with enforcementAction: deny for the same capability set.
